head: 1649b72978877d82b4d7662040ff3555dee0a3a7
finding: BE2-07 emits an exact candidate supersession event and has an in-memory recording consumer, but no adopted BE2-09 receiver applies the event to an exact dependent review/playback output under the required validity fence.
required_adoption: Define exact BE2-07 bundle-to-BE2-09 video/output lineage.
Adopt an idempotent public invalidation receiver or current-eligibility resolver in BE2-09.
Hold the BE2-07 invalidation fence through BE2-09 review commit and playback dispatch/fetch.
Specify duplicate, replay, lost-delivery, and stale-source behavior.
